meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 装上后,当你让它审查已完成的工作时,它会同时派出 5 个后台小助手,分别核对:目标是否达成、代码质量、安全性、实际运行是否正常、有没有遗漏上下文。五个全部通过才算通过,任何一个失败即整体不通过。
howto.when: 在提交 PR 前,或当你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。说「review work」「check my work」等指令即可。

say.text: 帮我 review 一遍这次的改动,看有没有问题
say.note: 会同时启动 5 个审查助手并行检查

say.text: 检查我的实现是否完整满足了最初的需求
say.note: 侧重目标与约束核对,会给出通过或不通过的结论

say.text: QA 我的工作,把应用跑起来验证一下
say.note: 侧重把应用实际跑起来做行为测试

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to review completed work, it launches 5 parallel background sub-agents checking goal fit, code quality, security, hands-on behavior, and missed context. All five must pass; any failure fails the whole review.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when you explicitly ask to review finished work, e.g. saying 'review work', 'check my work', or 'verify implementation'.

say_en.text: Review this round of changes for issues.
say_en.note: Launches all 5 review agents in parallel.

say_en.text: Check whether my implementation fully meets the original requirements.
say_en.note: Focuses on goal and constraint verification.

say_en.text: QA my work by running and testing the app.
